basis: Engineering judgment from this bounded audit and coupling analysis, not telemetry, measured demand, broad superiority evidence or authorization to add tools.
condition: Current independent verification and remote interoperability remain higher priority than new breadth.

batches.name: Text compatibility and log inspection
batches.workflow: Search compiler/log output, identify numbered locations, inspect binary string spans, and shape text for review.
batches.evidence: All listed spellings returned missing-handler on ours; baseline bounded text recipes passed.
batches.coupling: Command/VFS byte interfaces; no new shell grammar. Start only after current-feature verification priority is satisfied.

batches.name: Virtual repository and artifact inspection
batches.workflow: Split bounded artifacts, inspect a repository subtree, measure logical sizes, and identify content before processing.
batches.evidence: Baseline split/du/file matched intent; tree traversed the complete hierarchy but used a different display profile. Ours lacks these names.
batches.coupling: VFS traversal, symlink policy, byte bounds and honest metadata; remote-adapter workflows must be tested, not only memory fixtures.

batches.name: Reusable shell-script state
batches.workflow: Run existing agent helper scripts with option parsing, arrays, directory stacks and predictable environment/name lookup.
batches.evidence: Several ours primary scripts were prerequisite/parser-blocked; separate direct diagnostics confirmed all affected target names absent. Hash evidence proves map state only.
batches.coupling: Parser/runtime state, scopes and builtin/registry precedence; do not implement phantom type labels or command-only shims for grammar requirements.

batches.name: Bounded execution and lifecycle
batches.workflow: Bound an agent task, invoke real child commands, measure coarse elapsed time, and handle completion predictably.
batches.evidence: Baseline exec still ran the tail; wait is no-op proof-limited. The separate js-exec child retained resources despite successful guest output.
batches.coupling: Actual kernel dispatch, cancellation, budgets, child state and disposal; normal child success is not enough for exec/job semantics. Do not copy baseline no-op behavior as completion.

batches.name: Structured data and explicit guest runtimes
batches.workflow: Query configuration/CSV/databases and run small reproducible transformations inside a virtual filesystem.
batches.evidence: Baseline yq/xan/sqlite/Python recipes passed; js-exec produced42 but failed cleanup; node is a diagnostic stub. Ours optional SafeJS API is neither installed runtime proof nor a compatible name substitution.
batches.coupling: Format semantics, local runtime assets, legitimate injection, confinement and disposal; zero-runtime-dependency preference needs explicit design rather than private installs or native fallbacks.

lowestCouplingAuthorSlice.rationale: Two compatibility names can potentially reuse the existing public grep definition rather than require parser/runtime or a new data engine.
prerequisites: Verify existing grep extended/fixed semantics and invocation option ordering against independent frozen reference cases
Define reuse without bypassing CommandContext I/O/cancellation/budgets or adding host subprocesses
Coordinate aggregate exports/inventory and collision preflight with root owner
Require a different verifier for binary/stdin/pipeline/errors and actual memory/remote VFS workflows

deferralMeaning: Still retained and measured in the matrix; not erased or claimed unnecessary. Ranking chooses a next sequence, not a narrowed product scope.
